SELECT b.book_id, b.book_title, b.book_author, b.book_price, b.book_summary, b.book_cover, g.genre_id, g.genre_name, b.book_stock, b.book_publisher, b.book_flag FROM books AS b JOIN genres AS g ON b.book_genre = g.genre_id
AND b.book_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{form.name}, '%' )
AND b.book_author LIKE CONCAT('%',#{form.author}, '%' )
AND b.book_publisher LIKE CONCAT('%',#{form.publisher}, '%' )
AND g.genre_id = #{form.genre_id}
ORDER BY b.book_id
ASC
DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offSet}

AND book_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{form.name}, '%' )
